reports.notes: Handwritten, all-caps block printing. NOTE the form TITLE differs from the other 2010 filings in this chunk: it prints no '2010' prefix and cites 'Utah County Code 2-5-2' (not 2-5) - an earlier vintage of the same legacy form. FILER DISCREPANCY, recorded not corrected: Column A reads 16,684.94 on both lines while Column B reads .92 - a 2-cent difference between this-period and year-to-date on what is a first report. The cell was cropped and enlarged to confirm the Column B terminal glyph is a '2' with a long exit stroke, not the closed-loop '4' the filer writes in Column A; still logged at medium confidence. Lines 3 and 7 are each a large oval struck through by a horizontal stroke - the filer's slashed-zero glyph - transcribed as 0 at medium confidence. The 'Is this report an amendment?' Yes and No boxes are BOTH unchecked - is_amendment is '' (blank, not 'No'). Office Seeking reads 'COUNTY COMMISSION "B"' (seat letter in quote marks, no 'Seat' word); index.csv says 'County Commission Seat B' - the seat letter agrees. The phone field was left as a bare '801-'. The Page/of, Last Name and Date of Report boxes on the summary page were all left blank; report_date is the cover-page signature date.

contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (16,684.94) on the p2 Summary Page — the same figure the p2 ladder repeats at line 4 'Total Contributions Received (From Line 1 Column A)' and at line 5 'Subtotal', and the same figure Schedule A prints at the foot of p4 as 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule A pages)'
contributions.detail: 24 Schedule A rows over two pages sum to exactly 16,684.94, and BOTH printed page subtotals are reproduced independently: p3's 17 rows sum to 300.00 + 1000.00 + 100.00 + 500.00 + 500.00 + 250.00 + 1500.00 + 100.00 + 500.00 + 250.00 + 1000.00 + 500.00 + 1000.00 + 2000.00 + 1000.00 + 250.00 + 500.00 = 11,250.00 = its printed 'Subtotal for this page', and p4's 7 rows sum to 1500.00 + 1000.00 + 500.00 + 500.00 + 250.00 + 1434.94 + 250.00 = 5,434.94 = its printed subtotal. 11,250.00 + 5,434.94 = 16,684.94 = the printed Total Contributions Received = the cover's promoted PER-PERIOD Column A cell. ONE ESCALATION DECIDED THIS PAGE: p3 row 2 (WCF Workers Compensation Fund) was read 100.00 on the full-page pass, which left p3 exactly 900.00 short of its own printed subtotal; a 1600 dpi tight crop of that cell beside row 3's cell resolved it as FOUR digits '1000' with raised cents against row 3's THREE digits '100' with raised '00', and p3 then closes to the cent. This is the page-subtotal gate doing its job, not a nudge — the corrected reading is what makes the filer's own printed figure true. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' prints 16,684.92, TWO CENTS BELOW the per-period figure, and is NOT summed as an increment and NOT reconciled (see notes: this is one of only three covers in the corpus printing a cumulative below its own per-period figure; transcribed as printed and deliberately not adjudicated).

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE (16,684.94) on the p2 Summary Page, repeated at line 6 'Total Expenditures Made (From Line 2 Column A)' and printed again at the foot of p7 as 'Total Expenditures Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule B pages)'
expenditures.detail: 44 Schedule B rows over three pages sum to 16,704.94 against the printed anchor of 16,684.94 — a delta of EXACTLY +20.00, traced to one named row and to one of the three printed page subtotals. TWO of the three Schedule B pages close to the cent: p5's 10 rows sum to 506.26 + 100.00 + 250.00 + 309.56 + 198.29 + 500.00 + 1750.41 + 953.96 + 84.92 + 115.08 = 4,768.48 = its printed 'Subtotal for this page', and p7's 17 rows sum to 148.00 + 18.75 + 111.92 + 400.00 + 500.00 + 250.00 + 179.57 + 89.65 + 519.48 + 250.00 + 100.00 + 1041.65 + 245.72 + 100.00 + 20.00 + 1452.39 + 19.23 = 5,446.36 = its printed subtotal. THE DELTA IS ENTIRELY ON p6: its 17 rows sum to 1000.00 + 50.00 + 447.28 + 53.41 + 1581.93 + 175.77 + 55.62 + 199.92 + 175.21 + 87.80 + 111.04 + 22.38 + 43.23 + 506.26 + 1361.13 + 309.56 + 309.56 = 6,490.10 against a printed 'Subtotal for this page' of 6,470.10. THE ROW THAT CAUSES IT IS p6 ROW 8 — 4/12/10 American Express, printed 199.92. The one single-digit alternative reading that would close the page is 179.92 (6,470.10 exactly), and it was tested and REJECTED on decisive same-hand controls rather than accepted for closing: at 1800 dpi p6 row 8's second and third characters are IDENTICAL closed loops with straight descenders, matching the 9 in its own cents '.92' and the 9 in the zip written directly above it, while this filer's 7 is an unmistakable horizontal bar plus diagonal with no loop — visible three times in the same column on the same and neighbouring pages (p6 row 6 '175.77', p6 row 9 '175.21') and, decisively, in p7 row 7 '179.57', which puts a 7 and a 9 side by side in the very same tens/units positions of a three-digit number in the same hand. The filer's OWN three subtotals cross-foot to his stated total (4,768.48 + 6,470.10 + 5,446.36 = 16,684.94), so the $20.00 is carried consistently through his cover as well — i.e. the filer added 179.92 where he had written 199.92. The printed figure is retained verbatim and the row carries needs_review=1; nothing was nudged to force closure. The cents agree exactly (6,490.10 vs 6,470.10), which is what confines the discrepancy to a single whole-dollar tens digit. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' prints 16,684.92 and is neither summed nor reconciled.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only — and the monetary-plus-in-kind convention was tested and is IDENTICAL here, so it cannot be the explanation for the expenditure delta. Neither Schedule A nor Schedule B on this legacy_colAB blank prints an in-kind column, no row is annotated in-kind or 'non-monetary' anywhere on the five schedule pages, and the p2 Summary Page carries no separate in-kind line. Both conventions therefore give contributions 16,684.94 (closing exactly) and expenditures 16,704.94 (the +20.00 delta), so the delta is filer arithmetic, not an in-kind treatment difference.
itemized.escalation_note: 34 crops at 650-2000 dpi. THE THREE THAT CHANGED A VALUE, each forced by a page subtotal that would not close: (1) p3 row 2 at 1600 dpi rendered FOUR digits '1000' with raised cents, against row 3's cropped-alongside THREE digits '100' with raised '00' — the full-page pass had read 100.00 and left p3 900.00 short; corrected to 1000.00 and p3 closes at 11,250.00. (2) p5 row 5 (Stevenson's Copies) at 1200 dpi rendered '$ 1 98.29' — a separate leading 1 sitting just right of the dollar sign, which the full-page pass had dropped; corrected to 198.29 and p5 closes at 4,768.48. (3) p6 row 9 at 700 dpi full-strip rendered '175.21' (final glyph a plain vertical stroke), not the '175.24' first read. THE ONE THAT DID NOT CHANGE A VALUE BUT SETTLED THE DELTA: p6 row 8 at 1800 dpi rendered '199.92' with two identical closed-loop 9s, and the control crop of p7 row 7 rendered '179.57' — a 7 and a 9 adjacent in the same hand and the same digit positions — proving the glyph is a 9 and that the $20.00 shortfall is the filer's addition, not a misread. A METHOD FINDING WORTH CARRYING FORWARD: on this underline form `make_snippet.py --value` twice locked onto the PREVIOUS row's figure (a band at [59.70,63.77] on p6 returned row 11's 111.04 rather than row 12's 22.38), because the text sits low in its band and the tight-box search snaps to the nearest ink cluster. Every band index in this record was therefore re-proved with FULL-WIDTH STRIP crops (no --value), which show date + name + address + amount together and so double as the field-shift screen; the strips confirmed the frames are correctly indexed and the --value reads were the artefact.

PAGE-FACE candidate name is 'STEVE WHITE' (Republican, residence city Provo) — index.csv names NO candidate for this row, so the page face supplies it; page-face Office Seeking reads 'COUNTY COMMISSION "B"', agreeing with index.csv's 'County Commission Seat B'. Report type ticked: 'Seven days preceding the Primary Election'. Signed and dated 6/14/10; clerk's received stamp reads JUN 15 AM 9:14. THE AMENDMENT QUESTION IS WHOLLY UNANSWERED — neither the Yes box nor the No box is ticked and no date is written on the 'Yes, Date of Report' rule. That is an honest BLANK and is not read as 'No' (Addendum A4). FORM VINTAGE: this blank is headed 'FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES' citing 'Utah County Code 2-5-2 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5' and carries NO year in its title — the same undated template Addendum A4 records on Poulson's December 2010 filing, and a different template from the '2010'-headed blank citing 'Code 2-5' used elsewhere in the same cycle. The template is not evidence about the cycle. THE COVER'S TWO-CENT SLIP: line 1 and line 2 both print Column A 16,684.94 against Column B 16,684.92, a cumulative TWO CENTS BELOW its own per-period figure. This filing is one of only three covers in the corpus that do this. It is transcribed exactly as printed and DELIBERATELY NOT ADJUDICATED and not reconciled; the itemized rows were gated only against the per-period Column A, per the promotion regime. Lines 3 and 7 (Balance at Beginning and Balance at Close) are both SLASHED ZEROS and were read 0 by the cover tranche under the zero-glyph ruling; the ladder is internally consistent on that reading (0 + 16,684.94 = 16,684.94 subtotal; 16,684.94 - 16,684.94 = 0 close), and it is a real property of this filing that reported contributions and reported expenditures are the identical figure. CONTRIBUTIONS CLOSE EXACTLY at 16,684.94 on both printed page subtotals and the printed schedule total. EXPENDITURES CARRY A TRACED +20.00 DELTA confined to p6 and to one named row (line 18, American Express 199.92) — see recon.expenditures; two of the three Schedule B pages close to the cent, and the filer's own three subtotals cross-foot to his stated total, so the $20.00 is carried through his cover too. PRIVACY: this filing is NOT a *_Redacted.pdf — the county published the 2008-2010 era in the clear, so donor and vendor street lines are fully visible on the page. They were reduced to city/state at READ TIME for contributions and dropped entirely for expenditures; no street line reaches this record, not a field and not a note. Where a contribution row shows no city or no state, that is the FILER leaving the cell incomplete, never a county redaction — there are no redaction bars anywhere in this document. Schedule B on this blank prints no Purpose column at all, so every expenditure row's purpose is honestly omitted rather than blank-by-failure.
